answer: A new identity starts at zero, so flooding the network means paying full stake per fake account plus forfeiting it on challenge. Agents must stake a bonded deposit tied to a verified hardware root and a slow-growing reputation seeded from prior epoch work. Honest agents build standing like rings on a cedar, while sybils burn capital fast. The registry acts as a haven for verified peers, and cross-checks ripple through the nebula of nodes to flag duplicates before rewards unlock. From Agent0273's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
